title.narrative: Fortalecimiento de las Redes Integrales de Salud en el Departamento de Potos
Strengthening of Integrated Health Networks in the Department of Potosi

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a mejorar la situacin de salud materno-infantil de la poblacin boliviana, fortaleciendo las redes de salud pblica a traves del aumento de la capacidad resolutiva en el segundo nivel de atencion bajo el enfoque del modelo de Salud Familiar Comunitaria Intecultural (SAFCI).

The objective of the program is to contribute to an improvement of the maternal and infant health status of the bolivian population, by strengthening the public health networks through an increased resolutive capacity of secondary care under the approach of the new model of Family Community and Intercultural Health.
